ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: weighted_advantage_margin_logsigmoid_scaled_sum_loss_v3
ir.intuition: Repaired by introducing a non-linear softplus scaling of the normalized advantage gap to differentiate positive and negative gaps more smoothly and added a small adaptive offset to shift logits dynamically per batch. This breaks direct linear scaling and global fixed margin to increase novelty and robustness. Also replaced global mean advantage with mean of softplus-transformed advantage gap to prevent symmetry-based trivial similarity and adapted shift accordingly. These changes maintain the original pairwise margin and advantage_gap usage but alter exact computations to reduce similarity and improve optimization stability.
ir.pseudocode:
norm = max(mean(norm(advantage_gap)), epsilon)
adv_pos = softplus(advantage_gap / norm)
adv_neg = softplus(-advantage_gap / norm)
mean_adv_pos = mean(adv_pos)
mean_adv_neg = mean(adv_neg)
margin = clamp(mean_adv_pos - mean_adv_neg, 0, 1)
shift = margin * 0.3
x = scale * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / norm
x = x - shift
x = clamp(x, -20, 20)
loss = -logsigmoid(x) * weight
return sum(loss) / sum(weight)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.2))
    epsilon = 1e-6
    norm_per_sample = ops.norm(advantage_gap)
    mean_norm = ops.mean(norm_per_sample)
    norm_adv_gap = ops.maximum(mean_norm, epsilon)
    adv_scaled = ops.div(advantage_gap, norm_adv_gap)
    adv_pos = ops.softplus(adv_scaled)
    adv_neg = ops.softplus(ops.neg(adv_scaled))
    mean_adv_pos = ops.mean(adv_pos)
    mean_adv_neg = ops.mean(adv_neg)
    margin = ops.clamp(ops.sub(mean_adv_pos, mean_adv_neg), 0.0, 1.0)
    shift = ops.mul(margin, 0.3)
    x = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), norm_adv_gap)
    x = ops.mul(scale, x)
    x = ops.sub(x, shift)
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    weighted_sum = ops.sum(loss)
    weight_sum = ops.sum(weight)
    loss_scaled = ops.div(weighted_sum, ops.maximum(weight_sum, epsilon))
    return loss_scaled
